title: JRE 2462 - Aaron Siri
guestBio: Aaron Siri is an attorney and managing partner of Siri & Glimstad LLP, where he focuses on civil litigation, constitutional law, and vaccine-related injury claims. He is the host of the podcast “Informed with Aaron Siri” and the author of “Vaccines, Amen: The Religion of Vaccines.”
tldr: Aaron Siri is a constitutional attorney specializing in vaccine-related litigation and injury claims through his law firm Siri & Glimstad LLP
He hosts the podcast Informed with Aaron Siri and authored Vaccines, Amen: The Religion of Vaccines
Siri focuses on civil litigation cases and constitutional law issues related to vaccine mandates and injuries
He discusses his legal work representing clients in vaccine injury cases and constitutional challenges
The episode covers vaccine policy, legal strategy, and Siri's perspective on regulatory issues
Siri addresses his background as an attorney and how he got involved in vaccine-related legal work
recap:
Joe brings on Aaron Siri, a constitutional attorney and litigation specialist who has made waves in the vaccine legal space. Siri is the managing partner at Siri & Glimstad LLP and has positioned himself as a go-to legal expert for vaccine injury claims and constitutional challenges to vaccine mandates. He's also the host of his own podcast called Informed with Aaron Siri where he digs into these issues.

The conversation centers on Siri's legal work and his perspective on vaccine policy from a constitutional and injury litigation standpoint. He discusses his law firm's approach to civil litigation and how he's gotten involved with cases that intersect vaccine policy with constitutional rights. Siri talks about his book Vaccines, Amen: The Religion of Vaccines and what prompted him to write it.

Throughout the episode, Joe and Aaron explore the intersection of law, policy, and public health, with Siri drawing from his courtroom experience and legal expertise. He explains the landscape of vaccine injury litigation and the regulatory framework surrounding vaccines. The discussion touches on how vaccine policy has been implemented and enforced, along with the legal challenges that have emerged from various mandates.
